transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?
I've been feeling really anxious and down lately, and I'm having a hard time coping with everything. It just feels like I can't handle my daily life right now.
How long have you been feeling this anxious and down? Did it start after a specific stressful event, or has it been going on more continuously?
I've been feeling this way for exactly five days now. It started right after a very stressful event happened, and these feelings hit me almost immediately after.
Was the stressful event something traumatic where you felt seriously threatened or in danger, and since then have you had unwanted memories, nightmares, or felt like you were reliving it?

No, it wasn't a life-threatening event like that, and I never felt in danger. I haven't experienced any nightmares, flashbacks, or felt like I was reliving it. It's just a highly stressful situation that I'm really struggling to cope with.
How much is this stress affecting your daily functioning, like work, school, relationships, or taking care of yourself?

To be honest, I feel completely overwhelmed and it has been really hard to keep up with my normal routine lately. Since it's only been a few days, I'm not entirely sure of the full impact yet, but everything just feels like too much to handle.
Can you tell me what the stressful situation was that started this, and whether it’s still ongoing?
I'm not quite sure or haven't really thought about what specific event triggered it. I just know that these feelings started about five days ago and it still feels very overwhelming right now.
Over these past five days, have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy, or mostly been feeling worried and on edge?

I have definitely been feeling really off for the past five days. To be honest, I'm not quite sure how to describe it. I can't really tell if it is more about losing interest in things or just feeling constantly worried.
During most of these past five days, have you felt sad or hopeless most of the day, or has the main problem been excessive worry and feeling unable to relax?
Honestly, I'm not quite sure because it feels like a mix of both. I've been feeling really sad and hopeless, but at the same time, I'm constantly worried and can't seem to relax.
Before these past five days, had you already been dealing with ongoing excessive worry for months, or have these symptoms only been happening since this recent stress started?

No, I wasn't dealing with any of this before. These symptoms only started five days ago right after that stressful event happened. Before that, I didn't have any ongoing worry or feel this way at all.
Compared with what happened, does your reaction feel much stronger than you would normally expect for yourself or for most people in that situation?

I'm not really sure, and I haven't thought about whether my reaction is stronger than what others might expect. I've just been so overwhelmed by how I'm feeling that it's hard to compare it to how anyone else would react.
Since this started, have you missed work or school, withdrawn from people, or had trouble doing basic things like eating, sleeping, or showering?
Yes, I've really been withdrawing from my friends and avoiding any social activities lately. I also missed some work recently because I just couldn't bring myself to go.
